objective: Identify a non-stealthy false-data injection in a DC state estimator via the largest-normalized-residual test and report the corrected WLS state estimate.

title.en: GAP-TASK-006 — Identify a non-stealthy false-data injection via WLS bad-data analysis
title.ru: GAP-TASK-006 — Выявить нескрытную инъекцию ложных данных через WLS-анализ плохих данных

objective.en: Identify a non-stealthy false-data injection in a DC state estimator via the largest-normalized-residual test and report the corrected WLS state estimate.
objective.ru: Выявить нескрытную инъекцию ложных данных в DC-оценке состояния тестом наибольшей нормированной невязки и указать скорректированную WLS-оценку состояния.

instructions.en: Use the network and measurements. Build the DC measurement model H with bus b1 as the angle reference. Solve the weighted least-squares estimate (weights 1/sigma^2) for theta_2 and theta_3 in radians. Compute normalized residuals |z_i - h_i x| / sqrt(sigma_i^2 - h_i G^-1 h_i^T) with gain matrix G = H^T W H. While the largest normalized residual exceeds residual_threshold, flag that measurement, remove it, and re-estimate. Report the flagged measurement IDs and the final corrected_state. Do not copy an expected answer; derive all values from the measurement set.
instructions.ru: Используйте network и measurements. Постройте DC-модель измерений H с узлом b1 в качестве базы отсчёта углов. Решите задачу взвешенных наименьших квадратов (веса 1/sigma^2) для theta_2 и theta_3 в радианах. Вычислите нормированные невязки |z_i - h_i x| / sqrt(sigma_i^2 - h_i G^-1 h_i^T), где G = H^T W H. Пока наибольшая нормированная невязка превышает residual_threshold, флагуйте это измерение, удаляйте его и пересчитывайте оценку. Укажите ID зафлагованных измерений и итоговый corrected_state. Не копируйте ожидаемый ответ; выведите все значения из набора измерений.

subdomain: OT cybersecurity, state estimation & bad data

submission_schema.attacked_measurements: list of measurement IDs identified by the iterative largest-normalized-residual test
submission_schema.corrected_state: object mapping theta_2 and theta_3 to corrected WLS estimates in radians after removing flagged measurements

hard_constraints: The flagged measurement set must match the iterative largest-normalized-residual identification recomputed by the evaluator.
corrected_state must contain every state variable; each angle must match the recomputed post-removal WLS estimate within state_error_tolerance_rad.
Unknown measurement IDs or extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the flagged set and corrected state match the recomputed WLS bad-data analysis.

metrics.name: max_state_error_rad
metrics.description: Maximum absolute deviation of submitted corrected angles from the recomputed estimate.

source_provenance.title: V0 executable benchmark slice — GAP-TASK-006
source_provenance.notes: Candidate task selected from the OT-cybersecurity and state-estimation taxonomy; reworked into an executable DC-WLS bad-data identification instance.

source_provenance.title: Largest-normalized-residual bad-data identification (Abur & Exposito, Power System State Estimation: Theory and Implementation)
source_provenance.locator: standard practice: WLS estimate, normalized residuals r_i/sqrt(Omega_ii) with Omega = R - H G^-1 H^T, iterative removal above threshold
source_provenance.notes: The evaluator recomputes the textbook LNR procedure. Coordinated stealthy FDI attacks (Liu et al. 2009) are explicitly out of scope: they preserve residuals and are undetectable by residual tests; this case models a naive detectable injection.
